description: Land Acquisition - Malambe, Kaduwela D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It involves the Minister of Lands directing the acquisition officer to take possession of specific land parcels described in detail with lot numbers, assessment numbers, boundaries, and extents. The content focuses entirely on land matters without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
